meta.selection: Parcels with DEEDAC >= 2 lying fully inside the sample box, ordered by an FNV-1a hash of GISLINK. Strata filled in that order from the servers' own answers: 4 within 30 m of PAD-US public land, 4 intersecting a 1% flood zone, 4 with no access road within 20 m; then the rest in hash order, 20 in all.

parcelSource.name: TN Property Boundaries Public Use service
parcelSource.note: Verification sample only — the service is marked not for commercial use and is retired (founder decision 2026-10-11). Personal and non-essential fields were removed 2026-10-11 (W3): parcels keep only ids, geometry, context layers and labels.

meta.labelMethod: Labels are the publishing servers' own spatial answers (ArcGIS query with the parcel polygon and a metre buffer) and USGS EPQS elevations — computed independently of the fact engine.
